title: Lane lint in a child repo with no lane-touched-tests job states what reads clear, and who may type --lint-unknown-ok there
why: Child repos have no lane-touched-tests job, so lane lint there reads unknown. The child lane on home #728 typed --lint-unknown-ok with a reason on the verdict line. The coordinator granted no flag and asked for the rule that allows it.
source: Coordinator 21:27 CST Nov 13; triage read the decision text.
note: Triage 21:27 CST Nov 13: decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job line 14 says an unknown refuses unless --lint-unknown-ok "<reason>" is given and the reason is logged; line 21 says the flag never lifts a stack stop, base check or cross-measure unknown. Neither line says who may type it. Past practice put it to the owner as a page act (items act-3126-lint-unknown-ok and act-lint-unknown-ok-3259, the second still open as item 775), so a lane typing it unasked may breach that practice. Unchecked by triage: the child lane's verdict line and the repo where it ran. Fix: the decision states what reads clear in a repo with no such job, and who types the flag; red case first. Not a lift of any guard. Coordinator 00:34 CST Nov 14 (relayed; its REST read of checks.yml at 00:33 CST: no touched job in q_max, degen, home, banchi, ios-adblock or joyous; mailaudit unread): lane lint reads UNKNOWN on every child head; refusal for q_max #1171 at 69756b1e1 quoted in owner item 822 pick-child-lint-unknown (grant the flag per PR in five repos, add a touched job, or have the tool skip). Past ruling own-775-b-wait: the unknown on #3259 stays unlifted. Waiting on the owner. Evidence 00:35 CST Nov 14 (batch runner 12 relaying runner 11, via the coordinator; runner 11 transcript, unchecked by triage): home #702 and #704 merged on the old route --batch-build NAME --ready --lint-unknown-ok with the reason "no lane-touched-tests draft run exists on <sha>; touched tests run locally by --touched-tests"; no plain lint pass in any child repo; degen: no head passed it (#702 merged by the owner); on stable the flag form is merge <pr> --confirm --lint-unknown-ok REASON, never run; mailaudit has no touched job either (main bbdf2268). Whether the owner approved the flag per PR is not read. Runner 12 reads only a lane adding the touched job as fitting the owner's rule; the coordinator recommends the per-PR flag; both are on item 822.
